title: Open Cloze: The First Photographs (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1-1.10) jednym slowem, tak aby powstal spojny i poprawny logicznie oraz gramatycznie tekst.
tasks.text: The earliest photographs look very different 1.1. _________ the bright, colourful images we take today. The first successful picture 1.2. _________ taken in France in the 1820s, after an exposure that lasted several hours. 1.3. _________ those days, anyone who wanted their portrait taken had to sit perfectly still for a very long time. This 1.4. _________ why people in old photographs almost never smile. As the technology improved, exposure times 1.5. _________ shorter and shorter. By the end of the century, ordinary families 1.6. _________ afford to have their pictures taken. Cameras gradually became small enough 1.7. _________ carry around in a pocket. 1.8. _________ the arrival of digital technology, film slowly disappeared. Nowadays we take more photographs in a single day 1.9. _________ our great-grandparents took in their whole lives. It is hard to imagine a world 1.10. _________ this everyday piece of magic.
